# charts/kargo/templates/_krestarter-cronjob.yaml :: ServiceAccount
{{/*
Builds a cronjob to restart specified workloads (deployments, statefulsets).
Useful for services that silently lose their database connection and stay
in Running state while being unusable.
A dedicated ServiceAccount with a namespaced Role (get/patch on workloads)
is created alongside the cronjob (least privilege, no kubeconfig needed).
@param .context   The caller's context
@param .args      The parameters for the restarter cronjob:
  - name            The name to give to the cronjob
  - cron            The schedule expression "0 6 * * *"
  - targets         The workloads to restart, eg "deployment/kano statefulset/mongo"
*/}}
{{- define "kargo.krestarter-cronjob" -}}

# charts/kargo/templates/_krestarter-cronjob.yaml :: Role > apiVersion, kind, metadata, rules
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: {{ .args.name }}
  namespace: {{ .context.Release.Namespace | quote }}
rules:
  - apiGroups: ["apps"]
    resources: ["deployments", "statefulsets"]
    verbs: ["get", "patch"]
chunks.excerpt:

kind: Role
metadata:

chunks.text:
# charts/kargo/templates/_krestarter-cronjob.yaml :: CronJob > apiVersion, kind, metadata
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: {{ .args.name }}
chunks.excerpt:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: {{ .args.name }}

chunks.text:
# charts/kargo/templates/_krestarter-cronjob.yaml :: CronJob > spec
spec:
  schedule: {{ .args.cron | quote }}
  # A restart that overlaps the previous one would double the rollout.
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          serviceAccountName: {{ .args.name }}
          restartPolicy: Never
          containers:
            - name: restarter
              image: bitnami/kubectl:latest
              command: ["/bin/sh", "-c"]
              args:
                - kubectl rollout restart {{ .args.targets }}
{{- end }}
